parent_objective: design a history-vs-control active-set selector after M1585 control-dominated result
blocked_by: M1585 broad pairability intervention is control-dominated and has only 7 clean history-vs-control directed pairs
supersedes: another broad pairability intervention without history-vs-control selection

public_gates: M1587 must design a selector whose primary criterion is history-vs-control separation
M1587 must keep M1585 as public diagnostic evidence rather than history-necessity evidence
M1587 must pre-register clean, dominated, and null labels
M1587 must decide whether the next implementation is selector-only or source-generation repair
M1587 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs selector objective after broad intervention evidence is control-dominated
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no simulator rerun, history interventions, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design weakens the history-vs-control gate
stop if design treats M1585 clean rows as enough for materialization
stop if design ignores high-speed endpoint absence
stop if design routes directly to training, PPO, promotion, or private holdout
fallback_plan: admit selector-only implementation over M1585 rows if it can produce useful clean/dominated diagnostics
admit source-generation repair if selector-only clean count is too small
route to branch synthesis if this branch is optimizing only fixed public rows
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1586 admits history-vs-control active-set selector design

admission_evidence: M1586 identified 7 clean history-vs-control directed pairs across 4 source edges
allowed_updates: M1587 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if design admits it
next_stage_criteria: selector or source-repair route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1587 is design-only; any later implementation must keep controls first-class and cannot claim L3 from clean margin rows alone.
history_necessity_tests: design source-diversity and high-speed caveat handling
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If clean rows remain source-small, record it and route to source generation or synthesis instead of weakening standards.
allowed_claims: bounded selector design over public M1585 diagnostics
no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A history-vs-control active-set selector can turn M1585's control-dominated result into a cleaner next source-generation objective.
success_criteria: design pre-registers clean, dominated, and null labels
design pre-registers source-diversity and control dominance metrics
design chooses selector-only implementation, source-generation repair, synthesis, or stop
training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export materialization and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design treats M1585 as history-necessity or level3 self-ID evidence
design ignores control dominance or high-speed caveat
design routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export actor-input changes or candidate materialization
decision_rule: M1587 passes if it designs the next history-vs-control active-set route before any replay, materialization, or training.
